objective: GOAL-P13-001 BATCH-003 repairs the two defects that independent review found in BATCH-002 (DEC-20260802-8227b9), in the order the reviewers converged on. A superseding contract EXP-PEC-49c773 replaces the defective extrapolation law of EXP-PEC-6be870; the superseded contract and its run are not edited.
